notes.title: Update - Add Hotkeys
notes.content:
[Add Hotkeys]
- Press the "F" key to "Buy EXP".

- Press the "D" key to "Reroll".

notes.title: Update - Bug Fix
notes.content:
[b][Bugfix][/b]
- "Steel Shuriken" Bug Fix
When locking the shop after equipping the "Steel Shuriken", 
Fixed a bug where weapons on sale after the wave ended would not display a price of 0 Gold.

notes.title: Update - Delete Effect, Text correction, Bug Fix
notes.content:
[b][Delete Effect][/b]
- Removed the flashing skill effect for "Ancient Starlight".

[b][Text correction][/b]
- Fixed the description of the "Demon" synergy.

[b][Bug Fix][/b]
- Fixed a bug where the damage bonus from the "Future Bow" weapon effect was showing on all "Future Bows".

notes.title: Update - UI Improvement, Art Change
notes.content:
[b][UI Improvement][/b]
- Displays the number of additional "gold pieces" needed to obtain more gold.
This feature can be enabled by toggling the "Show remaining required gold pieces" option in the Options.

[b][Art Change][/b]
- Changed the Minion summoned by the 5 "Steel" synergy to a new image.
We felt it was unnatural for them to be looking straight ahead, so we adjusted them to face sideways.

notes.title: Update - Art Change
notes.content:
[b][Art Change][/b]
- Changed the Minion summoned by the 7 "Steel" synergy to a new image.

- The image of the Minion that was previously used for the 7 "Steel" synergy is now used for the 5 "Steel" synergy.

notes.title: Update - Balance Patch
notes.content:
[b][Balance Patch][/b]
- "MF3" Synergy Buff
Critical Hit Chance Increased
(3) 25% -> 33%
(5) 55% -> 66%
(7) 100%

- "MF3 Axe" Buff
The distance between the sword and the player has increased : 1.2 -> 1.4

Increased the number of knives spawning around you based on your star rank
(1-star) 1 -> 3
(2-star) 3 -> 4
(3-star) 5

notes.title: Update - Boss Pattern Change
notes.content:
[b][Update - Boss Pattern Change][/b]
- The boss in wave 20 no longer has a red bar summon pattern,
and red spikes from the floor have been added.

notes.title: Update - New Character Added
notes.content:
[b][New Character Added][/b]
- Introducing "Jenny"
Collect all the "gold pieces" dropped on the floor at the end of the wave.

notes.title: Update - Button Additions and Edits
notes.content:
[Button Additions and Edits]
- Added "Restart" button
Added a button to the pause screen so that you can restart from wave 1 during the game.

- Modified result screen buttons
Changed the "Main Screen" button to "Character Selection" button.
You can start the next game a little faster.

notes.title: Update - Added Upgrades, Balance, Hell Cave Challenge, Border Thickness
notes.content:
[Added Upgrades]
- Added Upgrades related to Synergy.
[list]
[*] Future + 1
[*] Wild + 1
[*] Light + 1
[*] Ancient + 1
[*] Shield + 1
[*] Gun + 1
[*] Bow + 1
[*] Axe + 1
[*] Shuriken + 1
[*] Knuckle + 1
[*] Cannon + 1
[*] Spanner + 1
[/list]

[Balance]
- "Electric Spanner" 
No longer stuns bosses.
Can immediately use a basic attack after using a skill.

[Hell Cave Challenge]
- "Hell Cave Challenge" mode can now be played on all difficulty levels.

[Weapon Border Thickness Adjustment]
- Fixed the weapon border thickness to be consistent during combat.

notes.title: Update - Synergies, Characters Balance
notes.content:
[b][Synergy Balance][/b]
- "Axe" Synergy Buff
Life Drain increases
(2) 3% -> 5%
(4) 10% -> 12%
(6) 20% -> 22%

- "Ancient" Synergy Buff
Reduce Skill Cooldown Time
(2) 10% -> 12%
(4) 20% -> 28%
(6) 30% -> 48%

[b][Character Balance][/b]
- "Jack" Buff
You start the game with 4->9 more gold.

- "Smith" Buff
Possesses 2->3 potions that copy your weapon at the start of the game.

notes.title: Update - Hell Cave Challenge (Infinite mode)
notes.content:
[Hell Cave Challenge]
- After clearing Wave 20, you can continue to challenge the endless waves through the 'Hell Cave Challenge' button on the bottom right of the results screen.
- Except for level 0 and 5, the other difficulty levels of Hell Cave are currently being prepared

notes.title: Update - Weapon Balance
notes.content:
[b][Weapon Balance][/b]
- "Electric Spanner" Buff
The skill range of the turret summoned by the "Electric Spanner" increases depending on the Star.

[b][Upcoming Update][/b]
We are currently developing content that can be enjoyed after the 20th wave.

notes.title: Update - BGM, Character and Weapon Balance
notes.content:
[b][Background Sound][/b]
-Added 2 new background songs.
-Reduced the background music default volume slightly.

[b][Weapon/Ability Balance][/b]
-"Blade of Brilliance" Buff
"Blade of Brilliance" 3-Star Skill Size Increase

-"Knuckles of Ruin" Buff
Minions of "Knuckles of Ruin" also attack diagonally, depending on the direction of the monster.

-Life Drain Buff
"Life Drain" reduction per wave: 14% ->13 

[b][Character Balance][/b]
-"Smith" Buff
Possess a potion that copies your starting weapon.
-> Possess 2 potions that copy your starting weapon.

-"Jack" Buff
Start the game with 2 more gold.
-> Start the game with 4 more gold.

notes.title: Update-Modify effects, adjust sound
notes.content:
[Effect fix]
- The 3-Star Blade of Brilliance (Light Sword II) now fires a blue blade of light.

[Sound adjustments]
- Increased the default volume of background and sound effects.
- Added 1 new background song.
